text:
anna: Quick heads-up — our APAC rack numbers look off, allocation shows 88 but billing/invoice is for 100. Anyone else seeing a mismatch?
raj: I noticed this in the morning, vendor told us 12 units were marked as delivered but not yet reflected in the quota.
chris: Can you paste the exact command/output you used to spot it?
anna: Sure — ran the reservation dump: ```gcloud compute reservations describe redwood-apac-pool --format=json | jq '.allocations'``` output shows 88 allocated, env dashboard shows 100 billed.
sophie: Finance flagged an invoice for 100 this week, so we need to reconcile before month close.
procurement-liaison: PO#5482 — vendor updated shipment status to "in transit" but their packing list had a different manifest id, raising a reconcile ticket with their ops team.
raj: @procurement-liaison did we submit a quota/top-up request to the cloud partner for the extra 12 or was that supposed to be auto-provisioned by the vendor?
procurement-liaison: I submitted a request to partner (ticket PR-1129) at 1746593000; vendor acknowledged but provider hasn't applied the quota. They're investigating.
oncall-bot: [alert] Created watch: quota-delta-apac (threshold: abs(delta) >= 5 GPUs) — set to notify infra on changes.
chris: While we wait, recommend we avoid scheduling new burst jobs to that pool. We can pin autoscaler lower or target other pools. Quick terraform snippet to limit capacity: ```terraform apply -target=module.pools.apac -var 'max_capacity=88'``` 
anna: Done — flipped the temporary flag FF:apac_pool_burst=false to stop autoscaling into APAC pool.
sophie: I'll update the on-call rotation notes and finance ticket with the temporary cap.
raj: I'll reach out to vendor contact (alice@vendor.com) and push them for the packing list reconciliation. If we don't have an answer by EOD we'll failover demo jobs to EU pool.
procurement-liaison: Vendor called — they found a packing-list mismatch, ops reissued the manifest and promised a status update in ~90 mins.
anna: Great, thanks everyone. Keeping thread open until vendor / partner confirms the 12 units are reflected in quota. :thumbsup:
